info.description: Empire website and CMS API. The browser calls `/api/*` on the site and Next.js forwards it here. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json. Staff calls use the `__Host-empire_session` cookie; writes also send `X-CSRF-Token` (from `/api/v1/auth/me`). `x-permission` names the permission an operation needs (handbook/ARCHITECTURE.md §11).
info.title: Empire API

post.description: Short links are followed on the server only, hop by hop, to an allowlist of Google Maps hosts over https: at most 5 redirects, 5 s in total, headers only. Anything else answers 422 with a reason staff can act on.

link; the old file stays in the library. Pages and posts arrive in part 4.

Hidden items can't be the cover; hiding the cover unpins it. A live project's RERA QR

post.description:
422 when the reply doesn't verify or match an upload you started in the last hour,
or when the stored file isn't what was signed for. A refused file is destroyed by the
outbox (the next sweep, at most 15 minutes later).
